why.en: POP3S on port 995 starts TLS immediately. This only opens a TCP connection to a public mail server and logs in to nothing.
why.hinglish: Port 995 par POP3S turant TLS shuru karta hai. Ye sirf public mail server se TCP connection kholta hai, kahin login nahi karta.

expect.en: TcpTestSucceeded : True (or 'succeeded'). Results vary by network.
expect.hinglish: TcpTestSucceeded : True (ya 'succeeded'). Result network ke hisaab se badal sakta hai.

title.en: See the server certificate on POP3S

why.en: Port 995 starts with TLS, so the server shows its certificate first. This only reads the certificate and sends no mail commands.
why.hinglish: Port 995 TLS se shuru hota hai, isliye server pehle apna certificate dikhata hai. Ye sirf certificate padhta hai, koi mail command nahi bhejta.

expect.en: Lines such as the TLS version (TLSv1.3), the cipher, and a certificate subject for the server. Exact values vary.
expect.hinglish: TLS version (TLSv1.3), cipher aur server ke certificate subject jaisi lines. Exact values badalti hain.

title.en: Find the clear-text password in the capture

why.en: Open the lesson's .pcap in Wireshark and filter POP3 commands. In the port 110 scenarios the password is readable.
why.hinglish: Lesson ka .pcap Wireshark mein kholo aur POP3 commands filter karo. Port 110 wale scenarios mein password padha ja sakta hai.

expect.en: The PASS packet whose bytes include the password as plain text. In the POP3S scenario you only see TLS records instead.
expect.hinglish: PASS packet jiske bytes mein password plain text mein hai. POP3S scenario mein uski jagah sirf TLS records dikhte hain.

why.en: Every POP3 reply is +OK or -ERR. Filtering on them shows the whole flow quickly.
why.hinglish: Har POP3 reply +OK ya -ERR hota hai. Inpar filter karne se poora flow jaldi dikhta hai.

expect.en: In the bad-password scenario you will see the -ERR [AUTH] reply. Change it to "+OK" to see the successful ones.
expect.hinglish: bad-password scenario mein -ERR [AUTH] reply dikhega. Successful wale dekhne ke liye ise "+OK" kar do.
